style: 容貌・衣装は美術設定。記録室で自分の展示札を伏せる場面に使用する。

files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. A production-ready full-body character sprite of Omi, a historian in a lantern-lit fantasy exploration RPG. A solitary thoughtful adult scholar with wavy dark hair streaked with silver, warm brown eyes and a contemplative face. A faded indigo scholar's coat, ochre linen collar, slim leather belt, slate trousers and worn russet boots. Omi looks down with quiet humility while turning a small ivory museum display card face down at waist height, its plain reverse visible. Clear three-quarter front view, natural anatomy and readable face and hands, controlled painterly brushwork and softly modeled fabric, warm even lighting. Center the full figure from hair to soles on a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas, the torso centered, with comfortable transparent space on every side. The figure, clothing and small card form a single crisp silhouette against a genuinely transparent background.
files.prompt_ja: 用途は物語イラスト。灯に照らされた探索RPGの歴史家オミの全身立ち絵。銀色の混じった暗い波打つ髪、温かな茶色の瞳、思案する面持ちの学者が一人で立つ。色褪せた藍の上着、黄土色の麻の襟、細い革帯、石板色のズボン、履き込んだ赤茶の靴。腰の高さで小さな象牙色の展示札を伏せながら、静かに目を落とす。札には無地の裏面が見える。斜め正面向き、自然な体つき、表情と手の動きが読み取れる。抑えた筆致と柔らかな布の陰影、温かく均一な光。髪から靴底までの全身を縦長1024×1536の中央に配置し、四方に透明な余白をとる。人物と衣服と札の輪郭が透明な背景から明瞭に浮かぶ。
